name: UKWA UpRising, 5 April 2004

appearances.source: Introduced at ringside as Angelus Dellanuite and Cicatriz's manager.
Introduced at ringside as Synskin's manager.
Opens the broadcast addressing the Champions League field as UKWA's own President.

matches.note: A late replacement match after Koahaka attacked the originally scheduled Veronique backstage; Koahaka won, and the federation ruled the result stood despite an outside-interference disqualification call.
Cicatriz won by pinfall (the Faisca) after an initial disqualification against her was overturned under a no-disqualification clause in her own contract and the match restarted.
Angelus Dellanuite won by pinfall after a spinning kick; the finish is followed by an unrelated post-match angle in which other wrestlers brawl.
Main event. Protean won by pinfall (Elysium); the broadcast's own commentary names the winner as "Jacob Seldon," the same wrestler's own other name.

notes: A fifth result, a debut submission win for Joe Kame'eleihiwa over an originally-scheduled but unnamed opponent, is described in the broadcast's own text but not structured as a match here for want of a named opponent.
